title: fix(spec): the hook form offers refusals and texts only where HookSchema accepts them
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao25upKJEGo6EpwNBNHeRSB5)_

Fixes #36799
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwvndECT67oMnono1P

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 搭建者在工作室里编辑一个表达式写成的钩子时，不会再看到拒绝码和文案这两栏；JavaScript 钩子和旧式处理函数钩子照常显示。
- 属于「作者界面只提供保存时会被接受的东西」这条线，替用工作室写钩子的搭建者解决填了就保存失败的问题。
- 只改表单什么时候显示这两栏，钩子能写什么完全不变；万一条件写错，最多是该显示的栏没显示，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.metadata-form.ts`: the `refusals` and `texts` rows both carry one `visibleWhen`, `SANDBOXED_CODE_VISIBLE`, which is the test `HookSchema` refuses both keys by (`hook.zod.ts`, the refusals and texts refinements): shown for a `js` body, or for no body and a non-empty `handler`; hidden on an `expression` body. The form serves it as `{ dialect: 'cel', source: "data.body.language == 'js' || data.body == null && data.handler != null && data.handler != ''" }` (`defineMetadataForm` lifts the string, as for every other row).
  - Written without parentheses on purpose: the Studio form evaluator (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/predicate.ts`) splits `||` before `&&` and has no grouping, so a parenthesised group fails open. The const's docblock says so.
- No schema, no other form, no evaluator, no locale pack changes (label and help text are unchanged).
- `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`.

## Tests
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-declared-rows.pin.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` "hook.refusals and hook.texts are shown exactly where HookSchema accepts them" (the shared harness that already pins the action form's gated `refusals` / `texts` rows):
  - each row is offered once and its served `visibleWhen` equals `{ dialect: 'cel', source: <the predicate> }`;
  - for each row × five drafts (expression body, js body, handler and no body, neither, empty handler and no body), the predicate read against `{ data: draft }` equals "`HookSchema.safeParse` raises no issue at that key";
  - the predicate is read by a test-local reader of exactly the subset it is written in (`||` over `&&` over `data.path ==|!= 'literal'|null`, loose `null == undefined`, no grouping); any other shape throws, so a rewrite fails the pin. CONTROLS: the reader refuses a grouped and an `in` rewrite, and the schema refuses the key on some drafts and accepts it on others.

<details><summary>Readings at 8c37099a (base origin/main 815e882b)</summary>

- Premise at 815e882b: `git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/data/hook.metadata-form.ts | grep -c visibleWhen` = 0 (the card's `hook.form.ts` has since been renamed).
- The predicate through the real Studio evaluator (`evaluatePredicate` + `buildPredicateCtx` from `predicate.ts` at 815e882b, run under `node --experimental-transform-types`): expression body `false`, js body `true`, handler `'fn'` and no body `true`, neither `false`, handler `''` `false`; all five equal `HookSchema`'s verdict.
- Ablation on the committed fix, file restored with `git checkout HEAD --` after each (`git status --porcelain` empty): `visibleWhen` removed from `refusals` → `Tests  6 failed | 23 passed (29)` (that row's six pins); removed from `texts` → `6 failed | 23 passed (29)` (that row's six).
- Build: `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --concurrency=2"` exit 0 (83 tasks).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0 ("All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"); spec `typecheck` exit 0; `eslint` on the two changed `.ts` exit 0.
- `vitest run src/data src/system src/ui` in `packages/spec`: `Test Files  470 passed (470)`, `Tests  16505 passed | 1 todo (16506)`.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 86 derived, 86 run, every one exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero), 0 unrun.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- A hidden row keeps a value already written: an author who fills `refusals` on a `js` body and then switches the body to `expression` no longer sees the row, and the save is refused at a key the form does not show. This holds for every `visibleWhen` row (the metadata form does not clear hidden values); not widened here.
- Out of scope, for the seat to file (seat said it will): the Studio form evaluator fails open on a parenthesised group, so `field.metadata-form.ts`'s `percentDisplay` row and the currency row after it read TRUE on every field type (measured at 815e882b: `{ type: 'text' }` → `true`; the same predicate without parentheses → `false`).

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/spec/src/data/hook.metadata-form.ts`: `SANDBOXED_CODE_VISIBLE` and its two uses.
2. `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-declared-rows.pin.test.ts`: the new describe, `evalFormPredicate` and `refusedAt`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/metadata-form-declared-rows.pin.test.ts` shows 29 passing; delete `visibleWhen: SANDBOXED_CODE_VISIBLE,` from the `texts` row and the same command shows 6 failing.
